title: Give the Lunchbox One Landing Spot
caption:
The lunchbox isn't lost. It just doesn't have a home.

Pick one spot, like a tray by the counter.
Lunchbox, water bottle, ice pack: they all land there the night before.
Then nobody is hunting at the door.

Save this and set up the tray tonight.
